Before submitting your remix, check that you've followed all the rules, and make adjustments if necessary:
Only @RDash75, @Twin138956Scratch, @Burgnew_On_A_Laptop, @SmashBrosFan2020, @ZYellow, @ScratchTeen9300, @BarryFans, @AlexHatScratch2 and anyone who remixed are allowed to break these rules.
Rules marked with ⚠️ can only be broken by @RDash75, nobody else!
Rules marked with ☢️ can NOT be broken by anyone.
Rules marked with ❓ are optional - breaking them is allowed (unless it's too severely), but following them is recommended.

❓ 1. Remember REMIX ETIQUETTE: Notify people in the comments before starting a remix so people know not to accidentally split the remix tree's branches. If you don't intend to make a new remix branch, don't remix if someone's already commented that they're remixing.
☢️ 2. PLEASE be respectful to anyone - there's nothing too mean and don't try to ruin or raid it!
☢️ 3. DO NOT BREAK THE SCRATCH COMMUNITY GUIDELINES, so nothing too scary, gory, vulgar, or otherwise inappropriate!
⚠️ 4. Don't add or remove anyone from the breaking-rules list without RDash75's permission.
☢️ 5. Please remember you will remix again after 2 remixes by others.
⚠️ 6. You can dodge if you want. But please don't dodge too many times!
❓ 7. If there too many remixes, you can add a skip button to speed up the project.
⚠️ 8. Don't delete any of these rules or instructions or completely change the project's title.
9. Don't delete or destructively modify anything you didn't make, unless to fix glitches, errors, or rule-breaks or to remove unused scripts.
❓ 10. Please don't make your characters overly large; that'd waste space that could be used for more characters. It's recommended you keep larger characters nearer to the top or to the back layer so they block less ground.
11. Please refrain from add any characters that are static images, even if you animate them, background included or not (EG: A PNG or JPEG of a Minecraft mob or some other thing).
12. Please don't add an intro or outro on this project or else it will slow down this project!
❓ 13. Anyone on the breaking-rules list can add new rules if needed. Remember to add them to both the thumbnail's RULE RECAP comment and the Instructions.
